title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
task: Latent-space language modeling with next-concept prediction
key_results: 8.9B model achieves OLMo-3-7B loss using 51.3% of training tokens; outperforms OLMo-3-7B by 2.45 points downstream with 5.99-point gain on GSM8K
comments: Introduces explicit concept-level objectives alongside token prediction, showing that structured latent spaces can improve sample efficiency, though scalability beyond 8.9B remains untested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent space architecture and NCP objective independently improve performance

title: SenseNova-U1.5: Towards Native Unified Visual Intelligence

key_results: 8B-MoT model improves image fidelity, text rendering, and editing across extensive benchmarks; handles up to 4K native resolution with spatially coherent patch reconstruction
comments: Encoder-free, VAE-free architecture is novel but evaluation metrics and quantitative comparisons against baselines are not detailed in abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native unified modelling without separate encoders/VAEs enables end-to-end visual understanding and generation

title: SpatialBlock: Enhancing Spatial Intelligence in LVLMs via Synthetic Block-Stacking Problem
task: Evaluating and improving 3D spatial reasoning in Video-LVLMs
key_results: SpatialBlock-15k synthetic dataset (15K block-stacking problems) helps LVLMs outperform baselines and generalize to real-world spatial tasks; identifies Alignment as primary bottleneck
comments: Synthetic data approach avoids expensive dense geometric annotation, but transfer from block-stacking to real-world spatial tasks may be limited by domain gap.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Block-stacking tasks develop foundational spatial skills transferable to real scenes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal alignment is the primary bottleneck in spatial reasoning

title: EvoSafeHarness: Evolving Model- and Domain-Specific Harnesses for Securing Agents
task: Evolving model-specific safety harnesses for LLM agents
key_results: Reduces attack success rate from 45.6% to 10.0% on DecodingTrust-Agent with 3.3-point utility cost; achieves 82.8% utility at 0.0% ASR on AgentDojo, transfers to unseen AgentDyn suites
comments: Promising safety-utility frontier but relies on evolutionary search which may not scale to very large policy spaces; adaptive attacks remain a concern.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain semantics determine which safety relations must be enforced; model behavior determines where and how

title: Mi-Ripple: Restoring Images Degraded by Iterative AI Editing
task: Restoring images degraded by iterative AI editing
key_results: Grid artifacts reduced with 0.08–0.44 CIELAB lightness residual; paired regeneration reduces debris density by 45%
comments: Focuses on post-processing restoration rather than preventing artifacts at generation time; effectiveness depends on spectral isolation of periodic patterns.

title: X-AuT: Progressive Audio-Encoder Compression for Speech LLMs with Cross-Scale Distillation
task: Progressive audio-encoder compression for speech LLMs
key_results: Compressing from 18 to 16 layers reduces error from 5.61% to 5.27%; 14-layer model reaches 5.75% with 20.7% fewer parameters; cross-scale distillation outperforms self-distillation (5.55% vs 8.45%)
comments: Achieves significant compression but benefits vary across benchmarks; progressive pruning strategy is sound but requires careful layer selection heuristics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Progressive layer selection and cross-scale distillation preserve decoder compatibility better than direct pruning

title: Memory as Plans: World-Action Modeling with Memory-Grounded Planning

title: Consequences of overtones in Raman spectra for assigning nickel anode surface structures as NiO2 during alkaline electrolysis
task: Reassign Raman spectral features in Ni-based oxygen evolution reaction anodes using isotope labeling
key_results: Ni-based anode surface terminated by NiO2 (not NiOOH) under operating conditions; bands previously assigned to superoxides are overtones/combination bands; shifts at varying pH/potential rationalized by vibrational Stark effect rather than structural changes
comments: Corrects mechanistic understanding of alkaline electrolysis catalysis; demonstrates importance of comprehensive spectroscopic validation (isotope labeling + DFT) for structural assignment.
